I have seen many seasons, and at my age I do not buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot — it costs too much and I grow cassava and beans, not maize. I will put the manure from my chickens and goats on the land like last year, and use my own cuttings and seed because they have always fed me. My family will do the work with hoes since we cannot afford spray or hired labor, and I will wait for the rains as God sends them.
